email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content & Social Media Marketer role at Katoen Natie in Kallo. Your focus on turning logistics expertise and customer challenges into engaging content across business lines and regions immediately caught my attention.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I create SEO content and manage WordPress sites for clients in consultancy, e-commerce, and non-profit sectors. I've built and optimized sites like mirook.com and baverok.com, using structured data and AI search visibility to make content discoverable. I also handle content calendars and adapt messaging for different audiences, which aligns with your need to support Business Development Managers across Europe, the US, and Asia.

I'm a strong English writer, naturally curious, and comfortable challenging stakeholders to shape better stories. I'd welcome the chance to bring my content and social media skills to your international team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content & Social Media Marketer position at Katoen Natie. The opportunity to shape how a global logistics leader is perceived across industries and regions, by turning complex expertise into compelling stories, is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I create content that ranks and engages. I manage content calendars, write SEO blog posts, and adapt messaging for diverse audiences—from a Belgian youth chess champion to e-commerce stores and a pharmacists' association. For mirook.com, I built a multi-page site with structured data and an llms.txt file, and ran technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. This hands-on experience has taught me to quickly grasp complex topics and translate them into clear, audience-relevant content.

I am a strong English writer with a natural curiosity and a passion for B2B communication. I enjoy collaborating with stakeholders to uncover stories and challenge assumptions to create stronger narratives. While my direct experience is in SEO and content marketing, I have a solid foundation in social media integration and a keen interest in LinkedIn thought leadership. I am eager to apply my skills to support Katoen Natie's Business Development Managers and enhance the visibility of the Consumer Goods & Industry unit.

I am globally oriented, having worked with clients across different markets, and I am comfortable adapting content for various regions and audiences. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my content creation and optimisation skills to your dynamic team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Katoen Natie's content strategy.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Strong English writing and content creation for digital channels, including SEO blogs and website copy
• Experience managing multiple content streams and stakeholders for client websites across sectors
• Hands-on with LinkedIn and social media integration, adapting messaging for different audiences
• Curious and quick to understand complex topics, turning them into engaging content
• International mindset with experience working with clients across Europe and beyond
